title: Lecture 1 — vectors, components, and length
summary: Section 1.1: vectors in two, three, and n dimensions.
body:
Study vectors in two, three, and n dimensions (Section 1.1). This guide follows the published topic outline; it is not a class transcript.

Read the [Module 1 guide and recommended exercises](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/pages/1-vector-geometry), including the [reading and exercise PDF](https://canvas.kth.se/courses/65269/files/10687612).
